newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Becker to buy Dendy cinema chain.
newsitem.headline: Becker to buy Dendy cinema chain.

text.p: Film and television production group Becker Group Ltd said on Tuesday it would buy the Dendy cinema chain for an undisclosed sum.
"The acquisition of Dendy Cinemas and Distribution makes sound business sense," managing director Richard Becker said in a statement. Dendy is an art-house cinema exhibition group.

"The strength of Dendy in quality film distribution - coupled with Becker's leadership in independent film distribution - will provide significant opportunities for the future growth of our company," Becker said.

He said the acquisition will enhance Becker's presence in theatrical film distribution in the Australian market and provide the platform for the development of alliances with other exhibitors to future strengthen the quality film circuit.
Becker said it plans to retain the Dendy name and further enhance the company's presence in the theatrical movie distribution market.
Following the acquisition, Dendy Cinemas and Distribution would be a distinct business unit within Becker Group and would be managed by former owners Lyn McCarthy and Graeme Tubbenbauer, Becker said.
Dendy Cinemas operates six screens, four screens in Sydney and two in Brisbane. Dendy also has its own video label within the Columbia Tri-Star Home Video Group.
Becker said it was very pleased with the purchase price as the earnings expectation of Dendy equated to about one-third of Becker Group's current price-earnings multiple.
The acquisition, subject to the completion of due diligence and the resolution of property related issues, was anticipated to be completed by the end of August, it said.
At 1.45 p.m. (0345 GMT), Becker shares were one cent firmer at A$1.21.
